rationale: All currently documented symptomatic patients with RAB3A-associated spinocerebellar ataxia 52 (SCA52) who underwent neuroimaging exhibited cerebellar atrophy (5 out of 5 patients in OMIM #621535, as well as cases reported in Percetti et al.). No counter-examples of symptomatic carriers with normal cerebellar neuroimaging have been reported to date in the accessible literature. However, because SCA52 is an extremely newly characterized disorder with very few reported families, the apparent 100% penetrance must be viewed cautiously given the small total cohort size.

evidence.text: Neuroradiological reviews across the spinocerebellar ataxias emphasize that although cerebellar atrophy is standard, certain genotypes or early disease phases can exhibit absent cerebellar atrophy, which requires vigilance before assuming universal invariant penetrance across all potential stages of disease.

source.title: Neuroradiological Findings in the Spinocerebellar Ataxias
source.quote: The main NR characteristics of brain imaging (magnetic resonance imaging or computerized tomography) in SCAs were: (1) pure cerebellar atrophy; (2) cerebellar atrophy with other findings (e.g., pontine, olivopontocerebellar, spinal, cortical, or subcortical atrophy; "hot cross bun sign", and demyelinating lesions); (3) selective cerebellar atrophy; (4) no cerebellar atrophy.

conflicts: The total number of genetically confirmed symptomatic SCA52 individuals who have undergone brain MRI evaluation is extremely low (N ~ 5-10 across reported cohorts), meaning statistical power to rule out incomplete penetrance of cerebellar atrophy or normal neuroimaging during early symptomatic onset is limited.

new_directions.question_text: Does early-stage symptomatic SCA52 demonstrate normal volumetric MRI or does vermian volumetric reduction precede clinical onset?
new_directions.rationale: Determining whether vermian atrophy is present at symptom onset or during the presymptomatic phase in RAB3A carriers will establish whether normal cerebellar volume truly rules out SCA52.

new_directions.question_text: What is the degree of cerebellar hemispheric versus vermian volume reduction across monoallelic RAB3A variant carriers compared with age-matched controls using automated 3D segmentation?
new_directions.rationale: Automated volumetric pipelines (e.g., FreeSurfer) can definitively test whether atrophy is vermis-predominant or pan-cerebellar.
